title: Exercise resource
description: A resource (URL) paired with a list of exercises/questions extracted from personal notes, each optionally anchored to a page/slide/section and optionally carrying a hint.

url.description: Canonical source URL for the resource (paper, notes, lecture slides, etc.).

title.description: Short title/description of the resource, taken from the text after the comma on the URL line.

note.description: Any freeform commentary attached to the resource line beyond the title (e.g. 'I skipped some part of the notes').

tags.description: Derived/curated tags for filtering (subject area, author, etc.).

source_file.description: Which raw notes file (e.g. notes2.txt, problems.txt) this record was parsed from.

locator_kind.description: Whether this resource's exercises are anchored by page numbers, slide numbers, both, or unanchored.

id.description: Stable id, e.g. '<slug-of-url>#003', unique within the resource.

text.description: The exercise/question text, with any (Hint: ...) and (Page/Slide N) markers stripped out.

hint.description: Extracted hint text from a trailing or inline '(Hint: ...)' clause, if present.

value.description: Raw locator value as it appeared, e.g. '4', '99', '2.11(a)'.

number.description: Numeric page/slide number if it could be parsed as a plain integer.

sub_index.description: Position of this exercise among exercises sharing the same locator (0-based), for stable ordering/dedup.

search_text.description: Lowercased concatenation of text+hint, precomputed for fast client-side search.
